Mina (Partnerships): Quick planning thread: we're cutting Partner SDK v2 which changes auth normalization and response envelope. Need partner plan.
Ravi (Engineering): What exactly breaks?
Mina (Partnerships): Auth: X-Auth-Token -> Authorization: Bearer ; Response: {result:...} -> {data:{items:...}} ; error codes: 422->400.
Tess (Platform): We can ship a proxy shim for 6 weeks that rewrites headers and envelopes. Will add X-SDK-Deprecation header on proxied responses.
Omar (Marketplace): Marketplace connectors pinned to v1 will fail during installs. We need a one-click upgrade flow + an automated smoke test.
Ravi (Engineering): I'll add telemetry: sdk_version_by_partner and proxied_v1_count so we can target outreach.
Mina (Partnerships): Proposed timeline: announce (T+0), publish migration guide + CLI (T+3), enable shim (T+7 for 42 days), opt-in strict v2 (T+21), remove shim (T+56). Office hours week 2.
Tess (Platform): Rollout rules: canary 1% traffic first, monitor errors for 24h, auto-disable shim if >1.5% error delta.
Omar (Marketplace): I'll draft the email + listing copy. Add badge "SDK v2-ready" to listings.
deprecation-bot: Scheduled: partner-sdk-v2-deprecation notice will send to partners@redwood.ai on 2026-06-02T17:00:00Z
Mina (Partnerships): Action items: Ravi - telemetry + CI checks; Tess - shim + kill-switch; Omar - comms + one-click; Me - guide + office hours. Ping me for any high-risk SI partners.
